2610.13826.title: OpenPA: Forced-alignment-free Multi-granular Pronunciation Assessment with Mixed-transcript Adaptation
2610.13826.paper_summary: Recent advances in automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) have driven a shift from scripted to free-form assessment. However, existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines with forced alignment and separate feature extractors, limiting their practicality across response settings. In light of this, we propose OpenPA, a novel APA framework that leverages Whisper's cross-attention mechanism to jointly predict word- and utterance-level pronunciation scores without forced alignment. Through mixed-transcript adaptation and adaptive substitution weighting, OpenPA accommodates heterogeneous transcripts across closed- and open-response settings within a single model. Trained solely on speechocean762, OpenPA achieves the strongest overall performance among evaluated systems under in-domain closed and simulated open-response conditions, while maintaining its performance zero-shot on MultiPA. An additional cross-task evaluation on oral-cancer speech suggests its potential applicability beyond non-native speech.
2610.13826.paper_summary_zh: 最近在自動發音評估（APA）方面的進展促使評估方式從腳本化轉向自由形式。然而，現有的方法往往依賴於多階段流程，使用強制對齊和單獨的特徵提取器，限制了它們在不同反應環境中的實用性。鑑於此，我們提出了OpenPA，一個新穎的APA框架，利用Whisper的交叉注意力機制，無需強制對齊即可共同預測單詞和話語級別的發音分數。通過混合轉錄適應和自適應替代加權，OpenPA能夠在單一模型中適應封閉和開放反應環境中的異質轉錄。OpenPA僅在speechocean762上進行訓練，在評估的系統中，在領域內的封閉和模擬開放反應條件下達到了最強的整體性能，同時在MultiPA上保持零樣本性能。對口腔癌語音的額外跨任務評估表明其在非母語語音之外的潛在應用性。
